name: thread-lines
title: Thread Lines
description: Interlace's own backdrop: a loose bundle of threads running across a section, crossing and parting the way strands do in a weave, with a small glint of light travelling along each one. It is the brand mark (two strands, interlaced) at the scale of a page.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/thread-lines

Installed to `components/ui/effects/thread-lines.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/thread-lines';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/thread-lines

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
